name: Elementary CA Spacetime
desc: A 1D elementary cellular automaton (Wolfram rules 90/30/110/... drifting by section) evolved row-by-row and streamed endlessly upward, its nested triangles and fractal veins age-colored across phosphor terminal, ink-on-paper, amber CRT, spectral, and thermal false-color looks.

density.doc: cell fill / structure richness (higher = denser field)

scale.doc: cell size / zoom (higher = chunkier cells, fewer columns)

speed.doc: upward scroll rate (rows streamed per second)

x.doc: horizontal pan of the toroidal field

y.doc: vertical position of the audio growth-edge glow

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
